note: First shop of the B07 Rue Commerçante covered arcade (same glass roof, honey limestone and dark oak shopfronts as the exterior arch): a general store with sage-green panelling and a black-and-white chequer floor under the glass skylight. LANDMARK: the giant ornate brass cash register on the long oak counter. The glazed door on the far left opens onto the cobbled arcade (way back out); the doorway on the far right shows the navy-blue bookshop (next shop). Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right; the adjective commercial sits mid-left. Zoom: the long oak counter (z1).
